preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= K for x in P.split())
preconditions.description: All elements in permutation P are integers between 1 and K (inclusive).
Permutation P has exactly K elements.

preconditions.expression: len(exchange_matrix) == K and all(len(row) == K for row in exchange_matrix)
preconditions.description: Exchange matrix is a K×K grid of 'Y'/'N' characters.

preconditions.expression: all(x in ['Y', 'N'] for row in exchange_matrix for x in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the exchange matrix is either 'Y' or 'N'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= K for x in result.split())
postconditions.description: All elements in the output permutation are integers between 1 and K (inclusive).
Output permutation has exactly K elements.

postconditions.expression: all(x in P.split() for x in result.split())
postconditions.description: Output permutation contains the same elements as input permutation P.

postconditions.expression: all(any(exchange_matrix[i][j] == 'Y' for j in range(K)) or i == j for i in range(K))
postconditions.description: The exchange matrix is symmetric (i.e., if i can be exchanged with j, then j can be exchanged with i).

postconditions.expression: all(any(exchange_matrix[i][j] == 'Y' for j in range(K)) or i == j for i in range(K))
postconditions.description: The output permutation is lexicographically smallest possible under the given exchange constraints.
